newsitem.title: CHINA: China Travel firm buys stake in China power plant.
newsitem.headline: China Travel firm buys stake in China power plant.

text.p: China Travel Service (Holdings) Hong Kong Ltd has bought shares worth 2.75 billion yuan ($331 million) in a power station in central China, the Xinhua news agency said.
China Travel had bought a 51 percent stake in the Weihe power station in Shaanxi province, Xinhua said in a report late on Tuesday.
The Hong Kong firm would hold the stock for 20 years, after which ownership would return to provincial authorities, the agency said.
The power plant, which went into operation last year, had assets totalling 5.4 billion yuan and had a generating capacity of 1,200 megawatts, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
